mapper.sql: id, message_id, message_type, exchange_name, routing_key, payload, status, attempt_count, next_retry_at, last_attempt_at, confirmed_at, returned_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_log (message_id, message_type, exchange_name, routing_key, payload, status, attempt_count, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{messageType}, #{exchangeName}, #{routingKey}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO message_log (message_id, message_type, exchange_name, routing_key, payload, status, attempt_count, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{messageType}, #{exchangeName}, #{routingKey}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE message_id = message_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM message_log WHERE ( (status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND next_retry_at <= NOW()) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND last_attempt_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) ) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE message_log SET status = 'SENDING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_attempt_at = NOW(), returned_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND next_retry_at <= NOW()

UPDATE message_log SET status = 'RETRY', next_retry_at = NOW(), last_error = COALESCE(last_error, '发送实例超时，自动恢复重试'), updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'SENDING' AND last_attempt_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{staleMinutes} MINUTE)
UPDATE message_log SET status = 'SENT', confirmed_at = NOW(), last_error = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status = 'SENDING' AND returned_at IS NULL

UPDATE message_log SET status = 'RETRY', next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND), last_error = #{errorMessage}, returned_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status IN ('SENDING', 'RETRY', 'PENDING')

UPDATE message_log SET status = 'RETRY', next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND), returned_at = NOW(), confirmed_at = NULL, last_error = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
AND status IN ('SENDING', 'SENT', 'RETRY', 'PENDING')
